requirement.normalizedRequirement: Take the design vertical ice bending moment along the hull girder as M_I = 0.1*C_m*L_UI*sin(gamma_stem)^(-0.2)*F_IB [MNm]. Use C_m = 0.0 at the aft end, 1.0 from 0.5*L_UI to 0.7*L_UI from aft, 0.3 at 0.95*L_UI from aft, and 0.0 at the forward end; determine intermediate values by linear interpolation.
requirement.section: Longitudinal strength - Design vertical ice bending moment
requirement.source: UR I2 Structural Requirements for Polar Class Ships
requirement.sourceText: The design vertical ice bending moment along the hull girder is to be taken as M_I = 0.1*C_m*L_UI*sin(gamma_stem)^(-0.2)*F_IB [MNm]. Use C_m = 0.0 at the aft end, 1.0 between 0.5*L_UI and 0.7*L_UI from aft, 0.3 at 0.95*L_UI from aft, and 0.0 at the forward end; intermediate values are to be determined by linear interpolation.
